title: alpha-court worker receipt v1
description: Structured delivery receipt a worker agent must emit as its final output. Facts only: the receipt reports what was done and what was run; it never grades its own quality. The commander-side referee reviews the diff and re-runs checks independently.

ticket_id.description: Ticket id exactly as given in the ticket header, e.g. 'v0.1-02'

status.description: done = all acceptance criteria attempted and passing locally; partial = some done, see deviations; blocked = could not proceed, see open_questions; failed = attempted but not working

summary.description: 3-6 factual sentences: what was built/changed and how it is structured. No self-praise, no quality claims.

branch.description: Git branch the work was committed to (output of `git branch --show-current`)

commit.description: HEAD commit hash after the final commit (output of `git rev-parse HEAD`)

worktree_path.description: Absolute path of the working directory the work happened in (output of `pwd`)

purpose.description: One line: why this file changed

self_test.description: Every verification command actually executed, with its real exit code. Report failures honestly - a receipt with a failing self_test and status=partial is acceptable; a receipt that hides a failure is a contract violation.

deviations.description: Every place the delivered work deviates from the ticket text, each with the reason. Empty array if none.

open_questions.description: Decisions the ticket did not cover that the worker had to guess at, or questions for the commander. Empty array if none.

notes_for_referee.description: Optional: anything the reviewer should look at first
